To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

5-HT induces a massive enhancement of sIPCS in pyramidal neuron through activation of 2A receptors and this effect is much weaker in interneurons, 5-HT increases sEPSCs in pyramidal through activation of 1A receptors, this effect desensitize slower than sIPSCs and 5-HT slightly decrease eIPSCs and eEPSC through activation of 3 receptors.
5-HT induces an initial inhibition of pyramidal neurons that is followed by a prolonged excitation.

5-HT induces a massive enhancement of sIPCS in pyramidal but only a weak enhancement in interneurons, and that 5-HT via the 5-HT(1A) receptor induces a transient enhancement of eIPSCs in interneurons.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of 5-HT on cortical neurons.
the cellular and molecular mechanisms underlying 5-HT modulation of excitability in the cerebral cortex.
the role of 5-HT on cortical synaptic activity, which may contribute to the regulation of cortical excitability.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
5-HT induces a biphasic response in pyramidal cells, with an initial inhibition followed by excitation.
5-HT is able to induce both inhibitory and excitatory effects in cortical neurons.
5-HT induces a complex and variable modulation of both excitatory and inhibitory synaptic transmission in the cerebral cortex.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
5-HT induces a complex pattern of excitation and inhibition of pyramidal neurons through a dual action on inhibitory interneuron activity.
5-HT is a potent neuromodulator that has a profound effect on the balance of excitation and inhibition in the cerebral cortex and thus on the excitability of pyramidal neurons.
5-HT is an important neuromodulator in the cortex, which can modulate synaptic transmission in both excitatory and inhibitory neurons.
The main takeaway from our work is that
5-HT can induce a large and sustained increase of inhibitory synaptic transmission in cortical pyramidal cells.
5-HT exerts a powerful and widespread action on cortical synaptic transmission, which may have important implications for cortical information processing.
activation of 5HT2A receptors can have a powerful inhibitory action on pyramidal neurons via a massive increase in the frequency of sIPSC.
